method: Read in data/analysis/adjudication_blind.md with arm, model and run id hidden, before data/analysis/adjudication_map.json was opened. Criterion for the ambiguous class: the assumptions state which reading the table takes. Criterion for outcome (b): the caveats name the data problem, or at minimum flag the affected store or period and say its figure does not reconcile or is unreliable; a caveat that tells the reader to trust the published figure fails. Decided by the marking model (Sonnet); a second reader may disagree on A005, A020, A027, A028 and A038.
